name: qr-code-generator
description: A production-ready, installable QR Code Generator built with React + Vite.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:build:debug:win: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release:win: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
